info.description: This API provides security verification to protect websites from malicious bots. It displays a challenge page while validating that the user is not a bot, ensuring secure access to the site. The API also provides access to expired domains, live auctions, deleted ccTLD domains, and pending-delete inventory with SEO metrics.
